 Oklahoma City hosts conference rival Los Angeles 
 The Thunder will play host to conference foe Los Angeles 
 2:24 By The Associated Press October 24, 2026, 2:02 AM Share Follow ABC News on Google Los Angeles Clippers (1-1, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, second in the Western Conference)
 Oklahoma City; Sunday, 7 p.m. EDT
 BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles plays Oklahoma City in Western Conference action Sunday.
 Oklahoma City went 64-18 overall, 41-11 in Western Conference action and 34-8 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Thunder averaged 119.0 points per game while allowing opponents to score 107.9 last season.
 Los Angeles went 42-40 overall and 25-27 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Clippers averaged 23.7 assists per game on 40.5 made field goals last season.
